title: Ask FloqR with BOT DEE
body: Ask FloqR with BOT DEE — tap the animated mark or wait for the prompt, then type what you want in plain words. Products: Mingl, RydR, BartR, ShoutOut, FloqCAST (superstar), clubs. Goals: say “I want to be able to…” (e.g. become a Club Admin) or “make me a superstar” for steps and links.
searchPhrases: i want to be able to

title: Ad Campaigns
body: Post a flyer image or a video of 30 seconds or less for your business, club, promotion group or service (DJ, photographer, promoter, FloqQ). Choose Inline ($45 / 7 days — Search loading splash and feature screens) or Mingl Gist ($25 / 7 days — story scroll), the run length and who should see it (age, gender, cities, interests). Pay by card or monthly subscription; approved accounts can use an invoice. FLOQR reviews every paid ad before it runs, and rejected ads are refunded. My ads shows the status, views, clicks and your invoice.

title: AI Recommendations
body: Ideas written for you from the venue, the event type, your draft and your profile. Every idea already fits the lines and characters your chosen display allows. Tap one to use it.

title: Archived ShoutOuts
body: Archive stores a compressed copy of your completed ShoutOut text and media (when the original included media) in low-cost Firebase storage, and removes it from Completed. Open Archive anytime to review past ShoutOuts. Re-Use still works from Archive.

title: Baller's Alert
body: $100 Baller's Alert — the Baller's Express BUSINESS metal card with your face under the warrior helmet. Use Upload photo → Photo library / files or Camera with face guide (one Upload control — no duplicate Take photo button). Gemini isolates you from the background (coarse edges — not salon hair matting); then zoom and position so only the face sits in the medallion. Helmet, rim, and chip stay. If background removal fails, retry or keep the original. Company is optional (max 18 characters, always UPPERCASE on the card; preset WE'RE OUTSIDE LLC). Valid Thru 12/50.

title: Become a Club Admin
body: Request Club Admin access, then get venue approval.
searchPhrases: I want to be a club admin

title: Become a DJ
body: Elect DJ as your service role and associate with clubs.
searchPhrases: I want to be a dj

title: Become a Promoter
body: Request Promoter access for guest lists and campaigns.

title: Booking Transaction Disclaimer
body: As a FloqR beta tester, you accept that reversing payments is difficult during beta. Ticket sales, table reservations, VIP entry, and other payments on beta features are final and non-refundable by FloqMedia. You participate at your own risk. Disputes about venue entry or payment must be resolved with the venue or the payment processor (e.g., Stripe, Papi, or Social OS).

title: Beta testing
body: FLOQR sometimes invites patrons to try new features early. The invitation arrives in your Inbox (and may be emailed). Open the link — if email opened a private browser without your FLOQR login, tap Sign in to accept this invite; after OTP/Google you return with the invite token. Tap ? next to the title for what beta means. Read the FloqR Beta Test Agreement (QA / not yet UAT, AS IS), accept both required checkboxes (Beta Test Agreement and Booking Transaction Disclaimer — details under the Booking ?), then tap I Agree and join beta. You see a clear confirmation that you joined and that consent was recorded. Only the features FLOQR chose for you then appear on Search with a Beta label. They may change or be switched off during testing. Invitations expire after 7 days and only work for the account they were sent to.
searchPhrases: sign in to accept this invite
try new features before everyone else

title: Black Card (retired)
body: Black Card was removed from the ShoutOut catalog. Use Baller's Alert instead — $100 with your face under the warrior helmet, optional company (max 18, UPPERCASE).

title: Explain My Recommendation
body: Each recommendation can show evidence, the date it was checked, whether personalization was on, and if a placement is sponsored. You can ask BOT DEE not to personalize this search.

title: VIP reserV from BOT DEE chat
body: Say book a table at Aurelia, hold a table, or I want a reservation in BOT DEE. The VIP reserV card shows nights, the 2D floor areas (Mezzanine, West Booths, Dance Floor, Bar Lounge), and tables. Tap a night, tap an area, tap a table (V1–V4 or AURELIA SUITE on the mezzanine), then Hold it, I agree to Terms, and pay if a deposit is required. Open VIP reserV map is the full pinch-zoom plan. BOT DEE never takes card numbers. Joining a Room SMARTview is not a payment.
searchPhrases: VIP reserV from BOT DEE chat

title: What BOT DEE knows of me
body: Facts BOT DEE stored with your approval live in Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE. The list is empty if memory is off or nothing is stored. Export or delete facts here. BOT DEE never stores your IP address. Mingl chats are not copied.
searchPhrases: What BOT DEE knows of me

title: BOT DEE saved chats
body: Open Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE to save chats after the pause, export, or delete history. The five-minute pause ends the live BOT DEE session. If you opt in, BOT DEE keeps that chat so you can come back later. Guests are not saved. Mingl conversations stay in Mingl.

title: BOT DEE
body: Chat with BOT DEE on the BOT DEE page in plain words: events and clubs, ShoutOut, Mingl, RydR, BartR, FloqCAST, your profile, staff schedules, or Club Admin tools. Press Enter to send a message; Shift+Enter starts a new line. Type help (like version) and BOT DEE explains itself and asks what you want help with. BOT DEE chats like a person (try How are you?) and only looks things up when you ask how to do something in FLOQR. If you are signed in, BOT DEE keeps this chat when you refresh or open another phone. After the pause timer, BOT DEE can recap where you left off — pause does not delete the chat, memories, or workflows. BOT DEE asks how it can help at the start of a conversation (and again if you come back after a pause). Mid-chat replies stay short. Answers use classification for your account. Signed-in BOT DEE uses the same public volunteered profile datapoints you can see (music, food, travel, hobbies, and the rest of Privacy datapoint sharing) — never email, phone, card numbers, or GPS. The + at the top right opens saved chats. Collapse and New chat only hide the canvas — BOT DEE still keeps that history and uses it on Send. Export or delete stays in My BOT DEE. Saved chats, memories, and approved facts live in My Profile → Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE. Tap a photo in the chat to pop it out into a separate window. Close with X or Close to see the chat again.

title: Ask BOT DEE for FLOQR venues
body: Ask in plain words — sushi restaurants in Washington DC, clubs in DC, or a named club. BOT DEE searches onboarded FLOQR venues only, not Google or Yelp. Matching clubs open a compact Place SMARTview (name, short blurb, ratings, public-page link) with a SMARTbackground — not a photo well. Patron photos and ShoutOut / VIP pitches stay off unless you asked for those. If nothing is onboarded yet, BOT DEE says so.
searchPhrases: Ask BOT DEE for FLOQR venues

title: BOT DEE Privacy Assistant
body: Change what other FLOQR users see in My Profile visibility — BOT DEE does not add a second public switch. If web research attached the wrong person, you can dispute it here without changing your profile. BOT DEE cannot promise that a third-party site will delete the original page.

title: BOT DEE privacy and session
body: The five-minute pause ends this live BOT DEE session. It does not delete this signed-in chat, memories, or workflows. Opt-in copies in My Profile → Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE stay too. Guests stay ephemeral. Mingl chats are never copied here. Press Enter to send a message; Shift+Enter starts a new line. Type help or privacy on the BOT DEE page. The + control lists saved chats without deleting them. Collapse is visual only — Send still uses stored history. Name, tone, and recap live in My Profile → Feature & Orders → My BOT DEE — not as a button on the chat.
searchPhrases: remind me where we left off

title: BOT DEE Research Library
body: Save places and cards you asked BOT DEE about. A Google Place ID is not a copy of Google’s photos or reviews. You can refresh or delete a saved item. Licensed caches stay off until the provider is approved.

title: Room SMARTview
body: In BOT DEE chat, say Open Room SMARTview, Start a group chat, or plan a Cancun trip in plain words (Let’s plan our Cancun trip, Let’s plan a trip to Cancun, plan a Cancun trip, Cancun trip with friends). That opens the same Room SMARTview as Open Room SMARTview Cancun Trip — travel art and a sample Travel partner / Fly to Cancun Ad, not live flight or hotel booking. VIP tables tonight stay nightlife, not a trip card. Confirm opens a session. Invite Mingl friends only — host plus 7 guests. Guests can invite too. Joining is not a payment and does not open a shared tab. BOT DEE never takes card numbers. Private BOT DEE messages stay private. Site Chrome follows your Appearance theme.
searchPhrases: let's plan a trip to cancun

title: End Room SMARTview
body: Only the host can end a room. Ending does not charge anyone or erase other people’s private chats. An unpaid shared tab must be paid or voided first.

title: Invite Mingl friends
body: After you confirm Room SMARTview, Invite shows your Mingl friends only. Each invite is bound to that friend and lands in Inbox as Review BOT DEE invite. Not a public join link. Cap is host plus 7. Guests can invite more Mingl friends unless the host turns that off. Joining is not a payment.
searchPhrases: bring my friends into this conversation

title: Join a BOT DEE session
body: Open the Inbox invite while signed in as the Mingl friend it was sent to. Wrong account, expired, or revoked invites refuse. Joining the room is not joining a shared tab and does not approve a payment. BOT DEE never takes card numbers.

title: Remove someone from Room SMARTview
body: Only the host can remove a guest. A kicked friend cannot read further room messages. A model reply cannot kick anyone.

title: Share into Room SMARTview
body: Share this conversation never copies your private BOT DEE thread. BOT DEE shows a preview of selected shareable facts from this message, marked tentative. You can edit or drop facts. Private profiles and SMARTsummary stay out.
searchPhrases: share with my friends bot dee

title: Room SMARTview shared tab
body: Opt in first. Then add a line. Close as one payer or split. Only confirming uids are charged, via FloqR Stripe. Joining the room does not join a tab. BOT DEE never takes card numbers. Club POS is later.

title: Who is paying
body: Ask Who’s paying in a Room SMARTview to see opt-in status. Nobody is charged because someone said buy. Card last four stay on the payer’s own receipt.

title: People SMARTcards
body: When more than one public FLOQR profile matches, BOT DEE shows compact People SMARTcards in the chat: full-width photo first, then name and handle, then a compact SMARTsummary with no padded box. Tap a card to open that person’s full SMARTview — same stacked layout. Cards use the same public profile and SMARTsummary as SMARTview — not a second stored summary. Opening a card does not call Gemini.

title: Ask BOT DEE who someone is
body: Ask “Who am I?” to open your own SMARTview. Ask “Who is …”, “What do you know of …”, or “What about …” plus a first name, last name, display name, Mingl or FloqR handle, or a social handle (Instagram, TikTok, X). Matches use those identity fields only — not bios, likes, drinks, or genres. One match opens a People SMARTview card in the chat — not a markdown list or photo dump. Several matches show compact SMARTcards to pick from. Private, blocked, or unpublished profiles are not listed — BOT DEE will not confirm whether that account exists.
searchPhrases: Ask BOT DEE who someone is

title: SMARTsummary stays in sync
body: Edit your SMARTsummary in your default profile language. Save is immediate. Cards and SMARTview already showing you update from the same record. Translations to other FLOQR languages run in the background and never overwrite a newer edit. If you hide your public profile, block someone, or delete the account, those cards disappear. Gemini does not overwrite text you wrote.

title: View my SMARTview
body: View my SMARTview shows your People card from public-within-FLOQR fields, using the same Profile Media as your FLOQR public page — not venue or restaurant mocks. Edit my SMARTsummary changes the text in your default profile language. Save translates it to every other FLOQR language, including English. Master Admin → Features → BOT DEE → SMARTviews is where labeled mock venue and restaurant cards live. There is no live Places or Yelp.

title: SMARTview categories
body: Four tabs: Social, Dating, Dining, and Future Travels. Social opens on Music, then Nightlife, Sports, and Events. Tags are only what you shared — no duplicate headings and no invented trips, ratings, or relationships. Future travel shows only destinations you marked public.

title: SMARTview and Site Chrome
body: People SMARTview uses the viewing patron’s existing FLOQR Site Chrome (Nightlife, Traditional, Black Tiffany, White/Black, Purple & White, Black & Dark Green). There is no second theme setting. Changing chrome updates the card in place without losing your chat draft.

title: Edit your SMARTsummary
body: Only you can edit your SMARTsummary, in your default profile language. That language is the source — English is the source only when your default is English. Save is immediate. FLOQR then translates SMARTsummary into every other supported language, including English. Gemini will not overwrite text you edited unless you ask it to regenerate. If your public profile changes, FLOQR asks you to review the summary instead of replacing it.

title: SMARTview photos and videos
body: The compact card uses the same hero as your FLOQR public profile — the first Profile Media item (8 photos + 2 videos). Tap it for Photos and Videos from those public slots. Swipe or use arrows, then X (or Escape) to return to the same chat scroll and unsent draft.

title: SMARTview privacy and visibility
body: SMARTview shows only fields you already made public within FLOQR. It is not open-web search. Dating appears only with explicit opt-in. Hide a field in My Profile and it leaves SMARTview. Blocked people cannot see your card. Report an incorrect summary from the summary overlay.

title: Review and correct a SMARTsummary
body: Gemini drafts the SMARTsummary in your default profile language from public-within-FLOQR fields only — never on each view. If a fact is wrong, hide the source field in Profile visibility or edit the SMARTsummary yourself. Owner-authored text is not overwritten. Profile changes that conflict with your summary ask for a review. Report an incorrect card from the summary overlay.

title: How SMARTview translation works
body: Your SMARTsummary is stored in your default profile language — that language is the source, even when it is not English. After you save, FLOQR queues a translation to every other supported language, including English. An English viewer sees the English SMARTsummary once that job finishes. While a translation is pending or failed, viewers see the source language with a clear label — never a stale translation presented as current.

title: SMARTview troubleshooting
body: Empty card: the patron hid those fields or you are blocked. Save failed: sign in and retry — translations queue on the server, not this browser. Pending or failed translation shows the source language with a label. Edit is owner-only. Master Admin SMARTviews is still the mock catalog; live Places and Yelp stay off until counsel. Theme follows Site Chrome — there is no second SMARTview theme.

title: Template search
body: Use the Search lens field (same design as Search) to find templates by name, description, tags, sports, VIP, media, or popularity. Results include official FLOQR templates, club-approved backgrounds, and your personal saved backgrounds. Each card is a true LED preview at the venue primary size with labeled Description:, How it works:, and Tag: lines — Use is the only action.

title: Version SMARTview
body: Type Ver, Vers, or Version — capitals do not matter. BOT DEE shows the version card. A longer question like “what is your version?” still shows that card.

title: Version SMARTview status is a live probe
body: Service status is probed on this Version request: Functions and package reachable with Gemini configured → Operational; Functions and package up but Gemini not configured → Degraded; Functions not in this request → Unavailable. It is never a static Not checked label. AI model shows the configured Gemini model id for this deployment even when this turn did not generate. Frontend and backend package stamps can differ; both are labeled. Master Admin may see extra diagnostics after Technical Details — patrons do not.
searchPhrases: Version SMARTview status is a live probe

title: Version SMARTview tabs
body: Overview describes BOT DEE and opens Technical Details without leaving chat. What's New lists verified BOT DEE and Gemini changes only — not Master Admin, beta tester tools, or other FLOQR product notes. Help repeats the Ver / Vers / Version command. Switching tabs or expanding details keeps your unsent draft and scroll. The card uses your Site Chrome — there is no second theme.

title: Site chrome
body: Beta: pick one Site chrome for the whole FloqR site. Nightlife (white script mark with neon cyan–magenta border halo), Traditional (charcoal / white + script FloqR mark), Black Tiffany (true black + Tiffany blue script mark), White/Black (white background, charcoal text, black script mark), Purple & White (true black + violet/coral), and Black & Dark Green (true black + forest green). Colors, cards, icons, FloqR wordmark, receipts, and chrome update together. Tap a card to apply instantly — saved as isSiteChrome (0 Nightlife, 1 Traditional, 2 Black Tiffany, 3 White/Black, 4 Purple & White, 5 Black & Dark Green). Available when FLOQR enables Site chrome and invites or assigns you. Find it under My Profile → Appearance → Site chrome (not Language Settings).

title: Classic Halloween
body: $15 Classic Halloween, at every club. The classic three-line ShoutOut board on a moonlit graveyard with jack-o'-lanterns, and emoji are welcome. At the end of each cycle, white ghosts burst out of a grave and rush toward the crowd while the Reaper rises and bats swarm. Type “Halloween” in Search, write up to three short lines, and add your @handle if you like. Plays on 96×48, 64×48 and 64×32 boards.

title: Club Admin venue assignment
body: Club Admins only open the Venue Command Center for a club they are assigned to. Opening admin.html without a venue no longer defaults to Zebbies. Demo accounts temp_clubadmin_N@floqr-demo.com map to temp-democlub-N. Unassigned admins request assignment from Master Admin.

title: FLOQR display screens
body: Firebase clubLocations stores VenueSupports96x48, VenueSupports64x48, and VenueSupports64x32 as 0 or 1. templates stores Is96x48, Is64x48, and Is64x32 the same way. A venue only lists a template when at least one pair is 1. Xibo URLs stay display.html?location=id and display2.html?location=id — screen size is not in the URL. Birthday is offered on all three sizes (3-line side-by-side on 96×48; photo/shoutout loop on 64×48 and 64×32). Primary is display.html. Secondary is display2.html.

title: In-app marketing
body: Post a flyer or a video of 30 seconds or less as your club. Once it is paid and approved by FLOQR it shows on the Search loading splash, Mingl, RydR and other FLOQR screens. Club ad posters lets a team member post ads for the club (Club Ad Poster role). No SMS credits required.

title: Marketing campaigns
body: Pick an industry template, load background and extra images, edit copy, then save or send. Sending debits SMS or WhatsApp credits from Messaging Credit.

title: SMS & WhatsApp Credit
body: Each $10 pack funds $7.00 of Twilio delivery capacity; FloqR keeps $3.00 as platform profit on the pack. SMS pack → 466 messages (≈ $0.015 all-in US SMS). WhatsApp pack → 233 messages (≈ $0.030 Twilio + Meta marketing). When balance reaches 0, buy another $10 messaging bundle before sending more campaign messages. Ops SMS unlock ($10) also grants one SMS pack. WhatsApp service ($10) grants one WhatsApp pack. Pack math: $10 → 466 SMS or 233 WhatsApp ($7.00 Twilio / $3.00 FloqR).

title: Club SMS and WhatsApp notification subscriptions
body: Club Admin → Notifications: Send test alert uses the boxes currently checked. In-app (and Push) writes a System Message in FloqR Inbox. Email uses club admin addresses. SMS and WhatsApp still need a paid subscription plus an E.164 alert phone. Green pill = Firebase subscription 1 (prepaid $10 pack); red = 0. If Send test alert returns Authentication Error - invalid username, Firebase secret TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID must be the Account SID starting with AC (34 characters) from console.twilio.com — not the Auth Token and not an API Key (SK).
searchPhrases: Club SMS and WhatsApp notification subscriptions

title: SMS notification subscription
body: The SMS pill is green when Firebase smsSubscribed is 1 (prepaid $10 pack, 466 credits, not monthly or yearly). Red/flashing means 0 — open ? and tap Subscribe $10. Credits remaining and last paid date are in this help. Uncheck SMS and Save to pause alerts without losing the paid pack.

title: Your club's templates
body: Templates made only for your club are listed first and marked Exclusive. Each card shows Description, How it works (for your primary LED), and Tag chips — Description and How it works are Master Admin–owned (read-only). You edit Tag chips only on club-owned templates via Manage template tags; shared FloqR Tag chips stay read-only. Assigned templates are what patrons can pick; use Assign or Remove to change that. Search finds a template even with a missing accent or a small typo.

title: Club website feed
body: Show your published FLOQR club page on your own website. Press Generate feed key and links, then paste the iframe code into your website, or give your web admin the JSON or RSS link. The feed shows upcoming events, featured DJs, featured staff, gallery, and contact details, following your Public page controls. Staff photos appear only when photo consent is confirmed. Generating a new key turns off the old links, including the staff schedule links.

title: WhatsApp notification subscription
body: The WhatsApp pill is green when Firebase whatsappSubscribed is 1 (prepaid $10 pack, 233 credits, not monthly or yearly). Red/flashing means 0 — open ? and tap Subscribe $10. Credits remaining and last paid date are in this help. Uncheck WhatsApp and Save to pause alerts without losing the paid pack.

title: Completed ShoutOuts
body: Completed ShoutOuts are club-approved (and finished) ShoutOuts kept for your records. Archive moves a ShoutOut out of Completed into Archive with compressed text and media (when the original included media). Re-Use opens Search to throw the same wording again. Save as my template appears only when the template background is modifiable (IsModifiable). Paid receipts stay in FloqR Inbox.

title: Create and publish a staff schedule
body: Add draft shifts on the people × days grid, review chips, then Publish schedule. Workers must confirm before a shift becomes confirmed. BOT DEE: create a schedule, publish schedule, how to schedule staff.
searchPhrases: Create and publish a staff schedule

title: Default Template
body: Free Traditional Black and White Classic. The card shows a true LED preview at this venue’s primary display size, then labeled Description:, How it works: (for that LED size), and Tag: chips. Tap Use to open the editor. Search above for public, club-approved, and personal templates by name, description, howitWorks, tags, or popularity.

title: Idle board: Use ShoutOut @ venue
body: When no ShoutOut is playing, Display 1 shows “Use ShoutOut @” followed by your venue name. Each approved ShoutOut plays for 10 minutes, then the board returns to that message on its own. Reset display to default in Club Admin does the same right away.

title: Do Not Sell or Share
body: Turn this on to opt out of sale/share-style personalization. FLOQR will not score ads with your profile tags. House and all-audience creatives may still show. If your browser sends Global Privacy Control (GPC), we set this automatically. Open the Privacy Policy for CCPA / CPRA details.

title: DonPapi ShoutOut LED wall
body: VIP ShoutOuts are carried by busboys on the handheld DonPapi LED wall — held in the air in front of patrons with the shoutout message on the center screen (club name at the top, glowing white scalloped border). Table LEDs (64×32) and portrait walls (960×1900) remain for other formats.

title: Employee / Worker Network
body: Only people linked to this club are listed: staff elected or approved here, club admins, and staff affiliated with this club. To give someone a role, type their name, username, or email under Elect Patron for Role, tap Select next to the right person, choose the role, then tap Elect Selected Patron Role and confirm. The person needs a FLOQR patron account first. Waiters, waitresses, and bottle girls on the list can be made customer service representatives (CSR).

title: Featured service staff
body: Tick the staff you want on your public club page. For each person, tap one of their FLOQR photos or choose Upload from computer. You can change the role shown under their name. Press Save Public Profile to publish your changes. Before publishing photos, get each person's agreement and tick the photo consent box.

title: Features SMARTview
body: Features SMARTview is the product catalog for BOT-DEE, Mingl, ShoutOut, RydR, floqCast, VIP reserV, Si-nema, and Si-tube. Open Overview, What's New, Feature Journey, All Features, Coming Soon, or Past/Retired. The catalog page opens without Search sign-in. Close dismisses the product detail sheet. Status is Production when Enable Feature is on and Enable Beta Feature is off, Testing when both are on, Beta when only Enable Beta Feature is on, and In development when Enable Feature is off. Coming Soon lists In development only. Dates stay Not verified — do not invent a release date. What's New stays empty until a reviewer approves a verified release. This is not Room SMARTview, not Version SMARTview. Plans are never treated as shipped.

title: Ask BOT DEE about a product
body: In BOT DEE say What can Mingl do, What can RydR do, What can floqCast do, What changed in ShoutOut, What is coming to Si-nema, or When was VIP reserV implemented. BOT DEE answers from the Features catalog with citations. It reports Production, Testing, Beta, or In development and will not treat a plan as shipped. Dates are not verified. Type Ver for Version SMARTview. Type Open Room SMARTview for a shared room. Those are different cards.
searchPhrases: Ask BOT DEE about a product

title: Production, Testing, Beta, In development
body: Features SMARTview shows Production (Prod) when Enable Feature is on and Enable Beta Feature is off — live for everyone, including ShoutOut's packaged default. Testing is both flags on. Beta is Enable Beta Feature only. In development is Enable Feature off. Coming Soon is In development only. Dates stay Not verified — do not invent a release date. Merged on is a pull-request merge time, not Available since. Released still needs deployment or availability evidence. SAMPLE catalog rows and conversation claims are not proof of a live release. Catalog products include RydR and floqCast (brand spelling floqCast).

title: Make me a FloqCAST / superstar
body: Pick a venue → private camera preview → pay $20 (Stripe pop-out) → Club Admin approves in the FloqCAST Queue → Go live on the FloqCAST board. Like a ShoutOut, but live video. Preview links use secret tokens so they cannot be guessed from a club URL.

title: Choose a FloqCAST venue
body: Search or choose a venue. The first four clubs are the nearest FloqCAST venues (GPS / localization). Cards show screen size and whether sound is supported. Type a club or event name to find more. Only clubs with FloqCAST enabled appear here.

title: FloqR / Mingl handle
body: FloqR / Mingl handle: letters, numbers, underscores (_), and dashes (-) only. No spaces, emoji, or other symbols. Shown as @your_handle on public profiles.

title: FloqR Inbox
body: FloqR Inbox holds System Messages and internal support messages. The list loads first so your messages appear quickly. Tap the floating New Message button to compose — type a name or @username to find an allowed recipient (Club Admin, CSR, or approved staff). Patron-to-patron chat stays in Mingl after both patrons Mingl back. Opening a schedule invite does not confirm a shift — review and Approve selected on Work Calendar.

title: FloqR account for Spatial Studio
body: Spatial Studio on FloqMedia uses your existing FloqR account. There is no FloqMedia signup. Guest drafts stay in the FloqMedia browser until you confirm attaching them to this FloqR account. FloqR issues a one-time authorization code (PKCE). Access tokens are not stored in the spatial project file.

title: Football Intro
body: A $30, 20-second stadium intro for four players, offered at Zebbies Garden DC, Heist Washington DC and Aurelia. Type “Football Intro” in Search, pick one of those venues, then upload four photos you have permission to use. Plays on 96×48 displays only.

title: Future Travel Destination (City or Country)
body: List cities or countries you want to visit next, comma-separated (Lisbon, Japan). Enter a city or a country, not a venue or neighborhood. FLOQR suggests standard spelling. When you opt travel in under Privacy, BOT DEE can use these destinations the same way as prior travels.

title: General Notifications
body: SOS2FA and other FloqR system messages follow these flags as set in a patrons your user record. Venues or specific independent service members need to subscribe to paid SMS/WhatsApp Twilio services

title: Generic ShoutOuts
body: Ready-made ideas for common moments such as birthdays and celebrations. Tap one to use it, then make it your own.

title: Location-aware search
body: FLOQR lists events and clubs closest to you first, then by name. When you allow it, FLOQR uses your phone or browser location (GPS); otherwise it estimates your city from your internet connection (IP). Type a place, like Clubs in Monaco, to search somewhere else — results there still start with the closest to you. You can turn location access off in your browser or phone settings.

title: About Mingl Requests
body: Sent and received Friend or Mingl Requests appear here. Requests stay on the main Mingl page; accepted conversations open in Mingl Chat.

title: About Mingl search
body: Search public profiles by shared interests, lifestyle, music, travel, food, events, cars, city, username, or who you want to meet.

title: Delete multiple scheduled or draft shifts
body: Select shifts, mix day headers and chips, then Delete selected. Example: all Wednesday drafts plus one Thursday confirmed shift.
searchPhrases: Delete multiple scheduled or draft shifts

title: Profile & Settings
body: Manage your profile, My Privacy, AI notifications, ShoutOut templates, public media, ShoutOuts, guest lists, FloqR Inbox, and Mingl. Open Profile & Settings for roles, seller tools, and account options.

title: Prior Travels (City or Country)
body: List cities or countries you have already visited, comma-separated (Barcelona, Miami, Spain). Use real place names — FLOQR suggests spelling from a city/country catalog, then Google AI Studio (Gemini) when you are signed in. This is the public Mingl travel datapoint when you opt in under Privacy.

title: Account type
body: Personal is the default FloqR patron account. Choose Business only if you need Ad Campaigns (Inline or Mingl Gist ads that Master Admin must approve). You stay a patron either way. Business shows a business-name field and the Ad Campaigns tab.

title: Country
body: Choose your country from the list. United States is first, then Canada, then featured nightlife markets, then every other country. The list is stored on this page so Profile loads quickly — it is not fetched from a database. Country sets your mobile calling code (+1 for the United States), the height unit default, and ZIP vs postal on taxi pickup.

title: Height
body: Choose ft or m first, then type your height in that unit. Feet uses 6'0". Meters uses 1.78. Mixing them is blocked — 1.78 cannot be saved as ft, and 6'0" cannot be saved as m. United States defaults to ft. Every other country, and a non-U.S. internet location, defaults to m. You can still switch the unit.

title: Mobile
body: Mobile is required. FLOQR uses this number to recognize you — one mobile means one FLOQR account. Country fills the calling code, for example (+1) for the United States. Enter only the rest of your mobile number. We store it in international format (E.164) so SMS and WhatsApp can reach you. If this number is already on another FLOQR sign-in, you will be asked to use that account instead of creating a second one.

title: Public Media and Data Sharing
body: Choose several images or short videos at once, then arrange their public-profile order. Profiles support up to 8 images and 2 short videos.

title: Role profiles overview
body: See how Club Admin, DJ, Promoter, and hospitality roles work.

title: Confirm assigned shifts
body: Inbox / Email / SMS links open Work Calendar. Look at each pending assignment, tick it (or Select all), then Approve selected. Opening the link does not confirm. Only the assigned service member can approve — Club Admin cannot confirm on their behalf.

title: Schedule message templates
body: Club Admin → Notifications → Message templates. These are System Messages (Inbox / Email / SMS / WhatsApp), not ShoutOuts. Edit title and body for New shift needs confirmation, Schedule update, Shift confirmed, and Shift declined. Placeholders: {club} {role} {when} {link} {worker}. Worker inbox uses Review & confirm shift — never Open Related ShoutOut.

title: Staff Scheduling
body: Plan shifts and bookings, then notify each person by Inbox, Email, SMS or WhatsApp. Under Schedule for, choose whose calendar you are working on: My DJ schedule is your own calendar, Club lists the clubs you manage, and Promoting company lists the companies you promote for. Each calendar has its own $20/month subscription. Shifts sent to you appear under My assignments, where you confirm or decline them.

title: Settings on Search
body: On the Home Search screen, tap Settings to open Profile & Settings on the Appearance tab — Site chrome (Nightlife, Traditional, Black Tiffany, White/Black, Purple & White, Black & Dark Green) lives there. The Settings tile uses the same chrome icon pack as the other Search marks.

title: Services & Service Members
body: Everyone starts as a FLOQR patron. On My Profile & Settings, tap Elect to become a service member to unlock this tab. Choose your service role (Waitress, DJ, Promoter, and more), search and select one or more clubs, then submit at the bottom of this page. Profile template guide — patron social profiles stay on Public Media. Service roles use dedicated profile templates on My Profile: • Patron — music, travel, hobbies, nightlife style, looking to meet; 8 photos and 2 short videos. • Promoter — active cities, events, guest lists, VIP tables, venue relationships, promo media. • DJ — genres, residencies, booking availability, mix links, crowd style, performance media. • Waitress / Waitress / Bottle Girl — venue experience, service style, languages, nights, bottle service, professional media. • Bus Boys or Security — floor support, door, security stations, venue experience, professional media. • Venue Manager — venues managed, ops specialties, staff coordination, professional media. Club Admin approval — each club's Club Admin approves your association after you submit. Club Admins: open Club Admin → Employee/Workers → Pending Worker Requests (Approve or Reject), or on this tab open Review & elect.

title: Shiloh
body: $30 Aurelia exclusive. Shiloh the cat sits on the left of the board and your ShoutOut glows in white on the dark side beside her. Emoji are welcome. Type “Shiloh” in Search, write up to three short lines, and add your @handle if you like. Plays on the board sizes Aurelia has.

title: Choose a ShoutOut venue
body: Search or choose a FLOQR club for your ShoutOut. The first four are nearest (GPS). Cards show LED display sizes supported and whether patrons can create custom ShoutOuts. Select a venue to continue to templates.

title: ShoutOut SMARTpreview
body: When you throw a ShoutOut in BOT DEE chat, BOT DEE asks for the template, whether to print your @handle on the FloqR card, and whether the board is text-only or needs a photo/video. ShoutOut SMARTpreview docks above the composer and follows this chat while you fill those in. The dock shows the live LED template (the same Display 1 composer preview) and updates when you pick a template, @handle, or text vs photo. Reply in chat or tap a chip. Photo and video boards still open compose. A true headless throw from FloqR or a third party does not use this card — pass venue, message, and optional extras in one request.

title: ShoutOut Recommendations
body: Pick a style and an event type, then tap Improve My ShoutOut for ideas that fit your template and display size. Tap any idea to put it in your message, then edit it if you like. Use Past ShoutOut brings back one of your earlier messages.

title: Si-nema virtual set
body: Si-nema loads a granted FloqMedia Spatial Studio project as a virtual set. FloqR stores the project id and the pinned revision only — photos, poses, meshes, and semantic geometry stay on FloqMedia. The first FloqR scene save starts a 48-hour edit window from that original server timestamp; later saves do not reset it. After 48 hours, edits need a separate authorization. A video model cannot preserve this geometry exactly.

title: Mingl Room SMARTnotification
body: A compact Mingl Room Invitation can appear on Search. View Invitation opens the Room SMARTview. Not Now dismisses it for this session. Art is a SMARTbackground illustration with SMARTstencils — not a real photo and not an official destination mark. Participant names and RSVP come only from the room record. A labeled Ad sample under the card follows the room tags (Travel partner / Fly to Cancun for a Cancun Trip). It is not a live advertiser. Private chat and prompt injection keep the slot empty.

title: Room SMARTview with SMARTvisuals
body: Room SMARTview shows the Mingl invitation: schedule, RSVP or live status, and Join Now. SMARTstencils and SMARTbackgrounds follow the authorized room title — Cancun Trip uses travel art, not a real Cancun photo and not an official partnership. Private BOT DEE chat is never used to pick art. Group rooms are not live yet, so Join Now does not create a room or charge. A labeled Ad below is a sample from those tags (Travel partner / Fly to Cancun). It stays empty for private chat or injection and is not a live advertiser.

title: Soccer jersey ShoutOut
body: Search Soccer, Jersey, or a country/club (Tanzania, Chelsea). Each photo kit card is the LED back you will see on ShoutOut — Soccer · Jersey · Country or Club. Sizes 96×48, 64×48, 64×32. Name and 2-character mark overlay the kit; numbers stay center-justified.

title: Staff marketing consent
body: When you join a venue or event team, you must tick the marketing consent box. It lets that venue or event organizer, and its admins and managers, use your FLOQR name, role, and published photos and videos on their websites, flyers, and social media (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and similar) without asking you again for each use. They may not publish your phone number or email. You can withdraw at any time in My Profile on the Services & Service Members tab. This stops new marketing; materials already printed or posted do not have to be recalled. Club Admins see each staff member's consent status in Employee / Worker Network and Featured service staff.

title: Staff Scheduling User Guide
body: Open the ? beside Scheduler on Club Admin Scheduling. Create draft shifts, Publish schedule so workers confirm pending→confirmed, then Select shifts to delete several at once. Example: all Wednesday drafts plus a Thursday confirmed chip.

title: Calendar & Scheduler
body: Club Admin Calendar shows Draft (purple), Pending (amber), Confirmed (green), and Open/unfilled cards — each with a written status, not color alone. Scheduler is the people × days draft/publish grid. Website ingest / publicVenueCalendar returns Confirmed assignments only. A green Paid this month pill is shown to Club Admins when staffSchedulingPaid=1.

title: Scheduler
body: Club Admin Scheduler is a people × days week grid. Save shift closes the editor with Schedule card successfully saved. Create drafts, Publish schedule so workers confirm pending until confirmed, Select shifts to multi-delete, and Website ingest to put published shifts on the club site. Default shift window = club open − 2 hours through close + 1 hour.

title: Work Sheet - Weekly Staff Calendar
body: Elected service members open Work Calendar in Settings. Inbox / Email / SMS confirmation links land here. Review pending assignments, tick each shift (or Select all), then Approve selected — opening the message does not confirm. The week grid shows published colleague shifts. Drafts stay in Club Admin.

title: Taxi pickup address
body: RydR pickup needs a street number, street name, city, state or province (for the listed countries), and ZIP or postal code. U.S. residents enter a ZIP (12345 or 12345-6789). Canada and other countries, or a non-U.S. internet location, use a postal code. FLOQR fills the label automatically from your profile country and IP. This address stays private on your account — it is not a public Mingl datapoint.

title: Template catalog report
body: Lists every ShoutOut template type and which LED sizes it supports (Is96x48, Is64x48, Is64x32). A venue only offers a template when at least one of those flags is 1 and the matching VenueSupports* flag is 1. Birthday / split-media templates are 1 on 96×48, 64×48, and 64×32. 96×48 is 3-line side-by-side; 64×48 and 64×32 loop the photo then the 3-line shoutout with a FLOQR + handle card.

title: Preview a template
body: Tap Preview on any template card to watch it play on a sample board with made-up text and pictures. Switch between the display sizes this venue has. Your own ShoutOut shows your words and photos.
searchPhrases: what does the template look like

title: Template tags
body: Under each template patrons see Description, How it works (for the venue LED size), and Tag chips. Club Admin and Template Administrators/Managers edit Tag chips only on club-owned templates (your tags replace catalog tags). Shared FloqR templates stay read-only — FLOQR / Master Admin owns those tags. Description and How it works are always Master Admin–owned. Add words patrons might type, such as game night or birthday. Template Managers can add tags; Administrators and Club Admins can also remove them. Assign roles under Role Activity & Permission.

title: Tengo muchos dólares
body: $30 Heist Washington DC exclusive. Your message plays in front of the vault for 5 seconds; then the vault door blows open and $100 bills splash behind your words for 10 seconds. The board closes with the HEIST logo over Washington DC, then loops. Type “Tengo muchos dólares” in Search, then enter only a name or pick an @Instagram / @Mingl handle (max 14). The board shows the name and types “Tengo muchos dólares... I just did a heist!” letter by letter. Plays on 96×48 displays only.

title: Trending ShoutOuts
body: Popular ShoutOuts approved by FLOQR, with picks that suit this venue's music first. Tap one to use it.

title: Venue Command Center
body: Approve ShoutOuts, review venue performance, and reconcile account activity for this location.

title: Venue opening hours
body: On Club Public Profile, set the default weekly open/closed hours, then add period overrides for special weeks without losing the default. The public club page shows a Sun–Sat week grid with the date range (e.g. Sun 9 – Sat 15, Aug 2026) and calendar coloring. Upcoming public holidays list open/close hours and call out when they differ from the usual weekday. Staff Scheduling uses open − 2h through close + 1h. Guest List can suggest open nights.

title: Club website ingest (API, RSS, iframe)
body: Club Admin → Scheduling → Website ingest. Generate a secret (shown once; only a hash is stored). Pull published staff shifts onto the official club website with JSON (?format=json&dataset=schedule|hours|profile|all), RSS, or an iframe snippet. Drafts, worker email, and phone are never included. Rotate the secret if it leaks.

title: Book a VIP table (VIP reserV)
body: Search a VIP reserV club, pick a night on the floor map, hold a table, accept Terms, and pay the deposit when the club requires one. Open VIP reserV from Search (when granted) or the profile menu. Choose a venue first, then the floor map and night, tap a green table (details open in a pop-out), hold it for 30 minutes, continue to the Terms page, and pay the deposit with FloqR Stripe (or confirm without checkout if the venue does not require a deposit). A table only shows booked/unavailable (isReserved=1) after that payment or no-deposit confirm — a hold alone stays amber. Bars and the DJ booth are never bookable. At Aurelia, use Explore 3D walk-through for the interactive room (2D map stays the booking UI). Brand name VIP reserV is never translated.
searchPhrases: hold a vip table at aurelia

title: Choose a VIP reserV venue
body: Only clubs subscribed to VIP reserV appear here. The first four are nearest (GPS). Cards show open days, minimum deposit, dress code, and age. Search by name, city, or genre, then Select venue to open that club’s floor map and night picker.

title: Club Admin VIP reserV management
body: Club Admin → Feature Mgmt → VIP reserV manages tonight’s reservations: check in, no-show, cancel, block/unblock sections, and walk-in book. Feature Mgmt also holds ShoutOut (Queue / Display / Template Mgmt) and FloqCAST. Firestore isBooked controls map booked status — set to 1 only after deposit pay (FloqMedia/Club Stripe), Club POS confirm, or admin-recorded payment. Cancel always clears isBooked to 0. For FloqMedia / Club Stripe, Cancel can also refund the deposit per the club’s refund policy (full by default, or hours-based partial/none). Club POS voids stay on Toast/SpotOn. Holds never set isBooked. Door staff can also use VIP reserV Door.

title: VIP reserV deposit before booked
body: Clubs set Require deposit before table is marked booked in Club Admin → VIP reserV. When required, holding a table only shows amber; the floor map turns red (booked/unavailable) after FloqR Stripe deposit payment — or after Club Admin records payment on a walk-in. If deposit is not required, confirming Terms marks the table booked without checkout.

title: VIP reserV door check-in
body: VIP Managers open VIP reserV Door for tonight’s list. Scan or paste a pass token, confirm ID 21+, then check in. Mark no-show only after grace. Opening a notify link never changes reservation status. Club Admin → Feature Mgmt → Passes issues guest/promoter QR passes, lists tonight’s passes, reveals QR, and check-in (ID 21+). VIP table Show pass on My Profile still uses the same pass.html viewer.

title: VIP reserV door pass
body: After your deposit confirms, open My Profile → Guest List & reserV (or ?tab=passes) and tap Show pass for a one-time QR. Open full pass opens pass.html. Bring ID 21+. Door staff use VIP reserV Door to check you in.

title: VIP reserV floor map
body: Green = available, amber = held (30 min), red = booked (only after deposit paid when required — or after confirm when the club does not require a deposit), grey = not bookable / blocked, blue = DJ booth. On phones the map opens on one area with chips to jump; pinch and pan; targets are at least 44px. Area names are club-editable; printed table labels stay as drawn. Decades, Lima Twist Club, and Aurelia each have a published 2D plan; Aurelia also offers Explore 3D walk-through.

title: Set FloqMedia Stripe for Aurelia (Demo Club)
body: Aurelia (temp-democlub-1) uses FloqMedia Stripe (FloqR Checkout) as the default VIP deposit collector — patrons pay on FloqR’s platform Stripe, then the table marks booked. Master Admin steps: 1) Open Master Admin → Features Mgmt → VIP reserV Payments. 2) Confirm VIP Reservations is enabled for the network (Features & Services / Release Control if needed). 3) Seed / refresh POS providers only if you also enable Club POS later — not required for FloqMedia Stripe. 4) Leave Aurelia on FloqMedia Stripe unless a live club needs Club POS or Club Stripe. 5) After deposits, open VIP reserV Payments → Network VIP billing to review FloqR settlements / invoices. Club Admin steps (Aurelia): 1) Sign in as temp_clubadmin_1@floqr-demo.com (Email OTP on home) or your Club Admin account assigned to Aurelia. 2) Open Club Admin → VIP reserV (location=temp-democlub-1). 3) Under Payment collector, choose FloqMedia Stripe (FloqR). 4) Keep Require deposit before table is marked booked checked for demos. 5) Tap Save payment collector — status should confirm FloqMedia Stripe. 6) Smoke test: vip.html?location=temp-democlub-1 → hold a table → Terms → Pay deposit (Stripe test card 4242…). 7) Door / billing: Open Door for check-in; Refresh billing for statements. Do not choose Club POS for Aurelia demos unless you intentionally connect Toast/SpotOn sandbox. FloqMedia, Stripe, ShoutOut, and VIP reserV stay untranslated brand names.
searchPhrases: Set FloqMedia Stripe for Aurelia (Demo Club)

title: VIP reserV payment collector & Club POS
body: Preferred for live clubs with Toast/SpotOn: Club POS — FLOQR books, holds, and maps the table; the POS owns deposit, open tab, and spend. Alternatives: Club Stripe (venue Connect from Club Admin → Stripe onboarding — FLOQR stores the account in stripeConnectAccounts, not a typed acct id), FloqMedia Stripe (FloqR platform), or VIP reserV engine + CSV. Aurelia (Demo Club) defaults to FloqMedia Stripe — ask BOT DEE how to set FloqMedia Stripe for Aurelia for the Master Admin and Club Admin steps.
searchPhrases: VIP reserV payment collector & Club POS

title: VIP table isBooked status in Firestore
body: Every VIP-onboarded club keeps one Firestore doc per table number for each night: clubLocations/{locationId}/vipNights/{YYYY-MM-DD}/tables/{tableNumber}. Doc id is the printed table number (e.g. T1, B3). getVipAvailability treats isBooked as the booking-status control for the floor map (booked only when isBooked is "1"). After payment completes (FloqMedia Stripe / Club Stripe deposit, Club POS confirm, or admin-recorded payment), isBooked is set to "1" and isBookedYes to "yes". Free tables stay "0" / "no". Holds do not set isBooked. Cancel always clears isBooked to "0" and, for FloqMedia/Club Stripe, can refund the deposit per Club Admin refund policy. Club Admin can call ensureVipTables to seed upcoming nights; getVipAvailability also ensures docs.
searchPhrases: VIP table isBooked status in Firestore

title: VIP reserV Terms & consent
body: After you hold a table, VIP reserV opens a separate Terms page with the full venue Terms text. Accept once (covers refund, no-show, age 21+, and minimum spend). Optional marketing is separate. Consent is stored with the Terms version hash before FloqR Stripe Checkout — then receipt and door pass, like a paid ShoutOut.

title: Welcome to FLOQR
body: Sign in with Google, Microsoft, Facebook, or a One Time Password (OTP). An OTP is a short code FLOQR sends to your email, by SMS (US and Canadian numbers only), or to WhatsApp (worldwide). Type the code within a few minutes to sign in — no password to remember. Each code works only once. Never share your code with anyone.
